verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global-employment (EOR, payroll, hiring) platform with an API, webhooks and embeddable components. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is an AI agent or assistant role, which is outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Oyster ships an agent or assistant that consumes MCP tools, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
